hypothesis: Qwen3-8B can recover six conversation-specific facts from two complete cleaned Codex conversations of roughly 10,000 to 16,000 tokens without RAG, chunking, summaries, or a hint about where each fact appears.

test.evidence: The model must name the numbered transcript message supporting every answer.
test.unknown_policy: Answer NOT_FOUND when the transcript does not contain the fact.

per_question_scores.1: partly correct or correct fact with wrong/missing support

evaluation.success_condition: At least 10/12 with the conversations and at least 4 points more than the no-context control.

privacy.public_result: Only redacted questions, model answers, scores, token counts, and opaque conversation labels.
